lines.en: It was a good night for Chika Chosokabe.
lines.zh: 对 Chika Chosokabe 来说，这是个不错的夜晚。

lines.en: She was taking either a step forward or backward depending on your motivations for being here and, for the first moment since her tongue departed her good friend’s clitoris, she was actually kind of happy.
lines.zh: 她是在向前迈一步还是向后退一步，取决于你出现在这里的动机。而自从她的舌头离开好友的阴蒂之后，她第一次真的感到了些许快乐。

lines.en: She wasn’t happy in the sense that things were going well, though. Just that they weren’t getting any worse. And that they probably couldn’t get any worse unless her boyfriend started fucking her little sister too.
lines.zh: 不过她的快乐不是因为事情在变好，只是因为事情没有变得更糟。而大概也不可能更糟了——除非她男朋友连她妹妹也一起干。

lines.en: It was a possibility, she thought. She hadn’t forgotten the time he brought her name up during discussions of a potential threesome, despite how much she wanted to.
lines.zh: 她想，这也是有可能的。她一直没忘，有一次在讨论三人行的时候，他提过她妹妹的名字——尽管她多希望自己能忘掉。

lines.en: That would be rock bottom, though. She’d probably just die if things ever came to that. But things would obviously never come to that because she had just solved everything!
lines.zh: 不过那就是谷底了。要是真到那一步，她大概会直接死掉。但事情显然永远不会走到那一步，因为她刚刚把一切都解决了！

lines.en: She’d managed to confront him and partially explain her stance and mindset in a mostly mature way, reminiscent of the way she used to be before the worm of Giles Corey began to eat away at her brain.
lines.zh: 她总算当面质问了他，并大体以一种成熟的方式部分说明了自己的立场和想法，有点像 Giles Corey 的虫子开始啃食她的大脑之前的那个她。

lines.en: But it all felt too easy. It all felt too simple. Which meant it all felt so wrong.
lines.zh: 但这一切都感觉太容易了。太简单了。也就意味着这一切感觉大错特错。

lines.en: This wasn’t the type of issue that could be solved in a single talk on the way home from work. This would require tears. Pain. Memories of hints that sneak in before late night panic attacks in the bathroom.
lines.zh: 这种问题不可能靠下班回家路上的一次谈话就解决。这需要眼泪。需要痛苦。需要在深夜于浴室里惊恐发作之前，悄悄溜进脑海的那些暗示的记忆。

lines.en: She was far too coherent for any of it to feel real.
lines.zh: 她条理清晰得过头了，以至于这一切都不像是真的。

lines.en: Which, in turn, led to her questioning just how much of what she knew was actually fake.
lines.zh: 而这又让她开始怀疑，自己所知道的东西里，到底有多少是假的。
: Chinami！我回来了！

lines.en: : Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，Chika 姐姐！你今天上班的时候 Chinami 好想你！

lines.en: Oh, good. She wasn’t being fucked.
lines.zh: 哦，太好了。她没在被干。
但她变得不一样了。

lines.en: What a silly girl she was — always using her femur to bash the dinner bell. Idling like the bed of Jesus as she gazes out the window, dreaming of peanuts and pancakes.
lines.zh: 她真是个傻姑娘——总拿自己的股骨去敲晚餐铃。像耶稣的床榻一样空转着，望着窗外，梦见花生和薄煎饼。

lines.en: : What are you doing, weirdo? Come give me a hug.
lines.zh: : 你在干嘛呢，小怪人？过来抱一个。

lines.en: : Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，Chika 姐姐！你今天上班的时候 Chinami 好想你！

lines.en: : Uh...yeah. Big sis Chika missed you too. And guess what? She ran into Papa on the way home. And she thinks she’s going to start trying to act a little more like her old self again so-
lines.zh: : 呃……对。Chika 姐姐也想你了。猜猜怎么着？她回家路上碰到爸爸了。而且她觉得自己打算开始重新表现得像以前的自己一点了，所以——

lines.en: : Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，Chika 姐姐！你今天上班的时候 Chinami 好想你！
: Chinami？
: 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，Chika 姐姐！你今天上班的时候 Chinami 好想你！

lines.en: : Yes. Chinami has said that many times now. Which means Chika is worried Chinami is sleepwalking again.
lines.zh: : 是啊。Chinami 这话已经说了很多遍了。也就是说，Chika 担心 Chinami 又在梦游了。

lines.en: She used her hand to shoulder. An act of reassurance. The kind that Mom would bake.
lines.zh: 她把手搭在肩膀上。一个安慰的举动。是妈妈会做的那种。

lines.en: : Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，Chika 姐姐！你今天上班的时候 Chinami 好想你！

lines.en: But when that shoulderbird don’t sing, we’re left to question how to make-
lines.zh: 但当那只肩上的鸟儿不再歌唱，我们就只能思考该如何让——
: Chinami……别闹了。别再怪怪的了。

lines.en: Coffee in each glorious way — each melodious aroma misconstrued.
lines.zh: 咖啡以每一种美妙的方式呈现——每一种馥郁的香气都被误解了。

lines.en: : Welcome home, big sis Chika! Chinami missed you while you were at work today!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，Chika 姐姐！你今天上班的时候 Chinami 好想你！

lines.en: With the creaking of seventh step, you’ll see what I am to you.
lines.zh: 伴随着第七级台阶的吱呀声，你会明白我对你意味着什么。

lines.en: : Chinami. Wake up. You’re doing it again.
lines.zh: : Chinami。醒醒。你又来了。

lines.en: : The one who really needs to wake up is you!
lines.zh: : 真正该醒过来的人是你！

lines.en: : Huh?! Who’s there?! What are you doing in my-
lines.zh: : 啊？！谁在那儿？！你在我——

lines.en: : Chika Chosokabe — your attendance is required for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium in nineteen years, eleven days, six hours, and fourty-four minutes.
lines.zh: : Chika Chosokabe——请你于十九年十一天六小时四十四分后出席「跨太平洋悲伤研讨会」。

lines.en: : The current temperature is a sweltering ninety-seven degrees Fahrenheit. You may experience difficulties using certain outdated technology due to the heat.
lines.zh: : 当前气温为闷热的九十七华氏度。高温可能导致您在使用某些过时设备时遇到困难。

lines.en: : The time of day is somewhere between 2:00 PM and 4:30 PM. The exact time is not currently able to be confirmed. We apologize for the inconvenience.
lines.zh: : 当前时间介于下午两点到四点半之间。具体时间暂无法确认。给您带来不便，我们深表歉意。

lines.en: : To show you how sorry we are, we cordially invite you to the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event. Please speak to your guide in order to request more information.
lines.zh: : 为表达我们的歉意，我们诚挚邀请您参加 Spacy's 的夏季狂欢特卖会。如需更多信息，请联系您的向导。

lines.en: : Everyone is right. I am going insane.
lines.zh: : 大家都说得对。我疯了。

lines.en: : Why would God...give me a gift?
lines.zh: : 上帝为什么……要给我一件礼物？

lines.en: : I’ve never been special at all.
lines.zh: : 我从来就一点也不特别。

lines.en: : I’ve done nothing to deserve this.
lines.zh: : 我没做过任何配得上这个的事。

lines.en: : Am I supposed to do something?...
lines.zh: : 我是不是该做点什么？……
: 你是什么意思？……
: 打扰一下？……

lines.en: She approaches the cube, which remains perfectly still. The way it always has. The way it always will.
lines.zh: 她走近那个立方体，它纹丝不动。一如既往。也将永远如此。

lines.en: She gazes into its depths, uncovering secrets of the earth’s formation. Every way to brew coffee. How to make yourself look even more beautiful for the person you love.
lines.zh: 她凝视它的深处，窥见地球形成的秘密。冲泡咖啡的每一种方法。以及如何为心爱的人把自己打扮得更美。

lines.en: There are so many answers packed inside that she can’t figure out what to ask.
lines.zh: 里面塞满了太多答案，多到她不知道该问什么。

lines.en: So she defaults to what an earlier voice told her.
lines.zh: 于是她默认了之前那个声音告诉她的话。

lines.en: : I’d like to know more about the Summer Blast Savings event at Spacy’s.
lines.zh: : 我想多了解一下 Spacy's 的夏季狂欢特卖会。

lines.en: She reaches out toward the cube.
lines.zh: 她朝立方体伸出手。

lines.en: She feels like she has to.
lines.zh: 她觉得自己必须这么做。

lines.en: It’s what everyone else in her grade is doing.
lines.zh: 她这个年级的其他人都在这么做。
成功。
终于，有了点什么。

lines.en: After being sucked into the cube, Chika Chosokabe awakens with a renewed sense of self — directly in front of the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event.
lines.zh: 被吸入立方体之后，Chika Chosokabe 带着焕然一新的自我意识醒来——正落在 Spacy's 夏季狂欢特卖会的正前方。

lines.en: And what she sees before her is nothing short of the most exciting thing in any context that she has ever seen.
lines.zh: 而她眼前所见，无论放在什么语境下，都堪称她这辈子见过的最令人兴奋的东西。

lines.en: Lovers! As far as the eye can reach with its fingers! So long as they’re nearsighted eyes that can’t escape the grips of the Great [[REDACTED] Mall.
lines.zh: 恋人们！多得手指伸出去能摸到视线尽头那么远！只要那是逃不出那座大[[已编辑]]商场的近视眼。

lines.en: As the pungent stenches of sex and body odor assault her senses, however, she can do little more than stand there in shock.
lines.zh: 然而，当性与体味的刺鼻气味冲击她的感官时，她只能呆立在原地，别无他法。

lines.en: So many penises! So many vaginas! So much moaning and groaning, turning and churning!
lines.zh: 好多鸡巴！好多小穴！好多呻吟与低吼，翻滚与搅动！

lines.en: But while her heart’s quickly burning, she’s suddenly learning that she hasn’t been crazy at all!
lines.zh: 但就在她的心迅速燃烧起来的同时，她忽然明白过来——她根本就没有发疯！

lines.en: One more misbegotten beguiling for the pile, she smiles — scribbling neatly of self-deceit on the back of a treat receipt before begrudgingly smudging her words in defeat. That cheat!
lines.zh: 又一场可悲的蛊惑堆进了那堆东西里，她微笑着——在一张甜点小票背面工整地写下自我欺骗的字句，然后又心有不甘地在失败中把字迹抹花。那个骗子！

lines.en: He had swooned her! Groomed her! Touched her from her head to her feet! Yet he’s been out on the street, calling others his sweet, while she slaved over a stove so her sister could eat?!
lines.zh: 他迷得她神魂颠倒！他调教了她！从头到脚地抚摸过她！然而他却一直跑到街上，管别人叫他的甜心，而她却在灶台前累死累活，只为让妹妹有口饭吃？！

lines.en: No! Unacceptable! But sad. So sad. She was so very, sad. She knew he meant no wrong! Sex is like bowling for adults. She just needed to get better at it. And she was in just the right place to do that.
lines.zh: 不！不可接受！但可悲。太可悲了。她是那么、那么地悲伤。她知道他没有恶意！性就像大人的保龄球。她只需要练得更好就行。而她现在正好就在能练的地方。

lines.en: She probably wouldn’t though, seeing as the only thing keeping her from vomiting in her mouth at the idea of someone else entering it was the fact that she had never seen so many dicks at the same time before.
lines.zh: 不过她大概不会——因为唯一让她没在「别人要进来」这个念头下吐在自己嘴里的，是她这辈子从没同时见过这么多鸡巴。

lines.en: : Thank you for attending the annual Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event. The sale is now complete.
lines.zh: : 感谢您参加 Spacy's 一年一度的夏季狂欢特卖会。特卖现已结束。

lines.en: : Please exit the store and find a partner for the dance as soon as possible. Refreshments will be provided for those in need of a break.
lines.zh: : 请尽快离开商店，并为舞蹈找一位舞伴。需要休息的顾客将提供茶点。

lines.en: : What the fuck is happening right now?
lines.zh: : 现在到底在发生什么鬼？

lines.en: : It’s the...Spacy’s...Summer Blast...Savings event! It’s the best...aah...orgy...of the year!
lines.zh: : 这是……Spacy's……夏季狂欢……特卖会啊！这是一年里最棒的……啊……群交……大会！

lines.en: : I’ve...gotten...nine different girls...pregnant today! My wife...is going to be...so proud! She’s always...wanted kids!
lines.zh: : 我今天……让九个不同的女孩……怀孕了！我老婆……一定会……特别自豪！她一直……想要孩子！

lines.en: : If you...still need a partner...you can...join me! I’m almost...done with...this one!
lines.zh: : 要是你……还需要舞伴……可以……加入我！我快……搞定……这一个了！

lines.en: : Noooo! I want more! Stay with me! I need it! I need more cuuuuuum!
lines.zh: : 不要——！我还要！别走！我需要它！我要更多精——液！
:（非常响亮的性爱声）

lines.en: : No...No...Sex isn’t...supposed to be like this! It’s...something you do...with...someone...someone you...
lines.zh: : 不……不……性不该……是这样的！它该是……你跟……某个人……你爱的……
: 我能请你跳这支舞吗？

lines.en: : What?! Huh?! Who the...what the fuck are you?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！啊？！你到底……你他妈是什么东西？！
: 孤独……
: 跟你……一样……

lines.en: : I...I have a boyfriend! I-I-I don’t “dance” with just anyone. Especially not creepy fucking monster things. Not even in my dreams. Sorry. Bye.
lines.zh: : 我……我有男朋友了！我——我——我不会随便跟人「跳舞」的。尤其是不会跟那种诡异的怪物玩意儿。就算在梦里也不行。抱歉。拜拜。
: 这里……没有人单身……
: 全都……想要……做爱……
: 绝对不行。走开。现在。滚。
: 大家都在做……
: 如果不是爱，那有什么关系？……

lines.en: : Because I’m not going make myself vulnerable for some...thing that probably wants to eat me!
lines.zh: : 因为我不会为了某个大概想吃掉我的……东西，把自己变得脆弱！
: 你做爱……只跟人类？

lines.en: : Yes. Human only. Boyfriend only. His name “Sensei.” I fuck him. He not here.
lines.zh: : 对。只跟人类。只跟男朋友。他叫「Sensei」。我跟他做。他不在这儿。
: 你在这儿。
: 对。我在这儿。
: 你在这儿……就是想要做爱……

lines.en: : No. For the last time, I-
lines.zh: : 不。最后说一次，我——
: 啊！Chika 姐姐！

lines.en: : Chinami didn’t know you were coming to the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道你也会来 Spacy's 夏季狂欢特卖会！

lines.en: : C-Chinami?! What are you doing here?! Get away from that thing right now!
lines.zh: : C——Chinami？！你在这儿干嘛？！马上离开那个东西！

lines.en: : Chinami loves the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event! She comes every year! There are so many nice ojii-sans who always give her tons of treats! All she needs to do is make them feel good.
lines.zh: : Chinami 最喜欢 Spacy's 夏季狂欢特卖会了！她每年都来！这里有好多好心的老爷爷，总会给她一大堆好吃的！她只要让他们舒服就行。
: Chinami……做什么？

lines.en: : Who’s that, big sis Chika? Is that your dance partner? I haven’t seen him here before!
lines.zh: : 那是谁呀，Chika 姐姐？是你的舞伴吗？我从没在这儿见过他！
: 你……好……漂亮姑娘……

lines.en: : He’s not my partner, Chinami! I’m in love with your papa, remember?! Good girls are only supposed to have one partner! Now please let go of that thing and come here!
lines.zh: : 他不是我的舞伴，Chinami！我爱的是你爸爸，记得吗？！好女孩只该有一个伴侣！现在请松开那个东西，过来！

lines.en: : That’s no good, big sis Chika! Everyone helps everyone at the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event! So it’s our job to make all of the ojii-sans feel good!
lines.zh: : 那可不行，Chika 姐姐！在 Spacy's 夏季狂欢特卖会上，大家都要互相帮助！所以让所有老爷爷都舒服，是我们的工作！
: Chinami！
: 怎么啦？大家都在做啊。
: 想……摸……漂亮姑娘……

lines.en: : Okay! Chinami will help two ojii-sans at once today! And she’s super experienced, so she’ll help you both feel reeeeeeally good!
lines.zh: : 好！Chinami 今天要一次帮两位老爷爷！而且她经验超丰富，所以她会让你们俩都舒——服得不得了！

lines.en: : No. Stop. I will do it. I will dance with the faceless ones. All of them.
lines.zh: : 不。住手。我来。我来跟那些无脸的东西跳舞。所有它们。

lines.en: : I will do whatever it takes to protect my sister.
lines.zh: : 为了保护妹妹，我什么都愿意做。

lines.en: : Aww, big sis Chika loves Chinami so much! But Chinami isn’t in any danger, so there is no need to protect her at all!
lines.zh: : 哇，Chika 姐姐好爱 Chinami 哦！但 Chinami 一点危险都没有，所以完全不需要保护她！

lines.en: : Maybe Chinami and big sis Chika can help our ojii-sans together?
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 和 Chika 姐姐能不能一起帮我们的老爷爷们呀？

lines.en: : Yes. That is a good idea, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 好。这是个好主意，Chinami。
: 大家都在做。
: 干……两个漂亮姑娘……一次……
: 这……是天堂……对吧？
: 这就是天堂。
: Chinami！
: 我回来了。
